name: Cracked Wood Cave
summary: Cracked Wood Cave is a cave in southeastern Cyrodiil, just northwest of Cropsford containing Bloody Hand goblins.
notes: The cave can also be entered by jumping into a large nearby hole in the ground, (map) causing you to land in a small puddle in the northwest part of the delve. However, prior to Patch 2.6.9, this could result in a bug where you got stuck at the bottom of the hole instead.
Cracked Wood Cave also appeared in Oblivion.
